title: Shopping list
intro: {name} orders everything in one go on Rohlík before the trip. Add what you'd like to have at the chata.
introNoShopper: We order everything in one go on Rohlík before the trip. Add what you'd like to have at the chata.
searchNotConnected: Rohlík search starts working once {name} connects their account. Until then, add items as text.
searchNotConnectedNoName: Rohlík search starts working once the banker connects their account. Until then, add items as text.
searchUnavailable: Rohlík isn't responding right now. You can still add the item as text.
unpriced: {count, plural, one {# item has no price} other {# items have no price}}
anonHint: Sign in to add what you'd like at the chata.
noParticipantHint: Only participants of this chata can add items.
shopperConnectIntro: Connect your Rohlík account. Everyone will then see real products with prices as they type, and you can send the whole list to your cart in one click.
nothingToSend: The list is empty so far.
sendAdded: Added {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} to the cart.
sendSkipped: Add {count, plural, one {# custom item} other {# custom items}} to the cart by hand.
sendFailed: Sending to the cart didn't work. Try again in a moment.
connectErrorToast: Connecting Rohlík didn't work. Try again.
unknownPrice: A question mark means we don't know the price yet.
receiptEmpty: Nothing here yet. Who's adding the first sausages?
sendHint: Sends only what hasn't gone yet. Anything Rohlík can't take comes to you by email.
sendEmailed: The list of what to add by hand is in your email too.
allSent: Everything's sent. The button turns on again when someone adds something.
handedOver: the banker adds it by hand
